name: 93292 · Visalia, CA
findings: ZIP 93292 (Visalia) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93292 (Visalia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
